Subject: Re: Unexpected invoice lines — trial credits vs token charges

Hi Anna — appreciate the detail. Short answer is: our PLG credits are issued as account credits, but depending on the export you pulled the system can show gross usage on the invoice and the credit as a separate line item or credit memo. That can look like a billed charge if your export is filtered to only show usage lines.

What I’m going to do now:
1) Confirm with billing whether the credit memo exists on your account (Neha will confirm).
2) If the net due is nonzero, we’ll create a corrective credit note for accounting.
3) I’m happy to approve a 14‑day trial extension or an equivalent promo to cover the test traffic while we fix the record.

Estimated numbers I see on a quick look: gross usage ~€36.40, promo credit applied ~€30.00, VAT shown ~€7.28, leaving a small remainder that looks like rounding/timing. Neha — can you check the precise numbers and confirm whether we should issue a credit to zero this out?

Also adding a HubSpot note for traceability (HS-98765).

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Account Executive, EMEA
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Unexpected invoice lines — trial credits vs token charges

Hi Anna — thanks for the invoice and VAT ID. I pulled the billing ledger for acct_nova_44A. Notes:
- The promotional free credits were added to the account on 2027-09-09 as a credit balance of €30.00.
- Usage was recorded on 2027-09-12 totaling €36.40 gross.
- A VAT line of €7.28 appears because our invoicing system shows tax on gross usage; the credit was applied as a separate credit item which (in some export views) doesn’t automatically reduce the single usage line. Net outstanding on the invoice currently shows €3.68.

I can do two things immediately:
1) Issue an official credit note that documents the promo credit applied and reduces the net to €0.00 (credit_note_draft.pdf attached for review). That will give you a journalable document.
2) Approve a 14‑day trial extension for Novacorp while we complete the credit. For corporate accounts we do ask for the VAT ID on the credit note; you already provided that which is perfect.

If you confirm you want the credit note issued I'll finalize and push it through today. Also attaching our short promo terms for record (promo_terms_redwood.pdf) — we typically keep self-serve credits automatic but when a manual correction is requested we include a simple acknowledgement for the finance team.

Neha Kapoor
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
